title: Highmoor Rising Again
author: Felix Dravenmoor
blurb: Ivo Brightwater, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, has spent twelve years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
